title: S Health is king
body: All my previous phones have been the galaxy series. This year i made the switch to an iPhone, because i wanted to try an Apple device. I still prefer Samsungs version, because it has a far better user interface, but thats just my opinion, to each their own right:)
author: ThePfChangs

title: Not suggested if you have iPhone
body:
Bought Samsung Galaxy Watch, and after several months the experience has gotten worse by day. Not a good match if using iPhone. 
But regarding Samsung Health app - not possible to see weekly/monthly TOTAL steps/kilometers, week starts with Sunday (no possibility to change that it would start with Monday). And when i wanted to send feedback via app (there is nice ask a question option), then during submitting comes error and thats it. Not a nice consumer experience!!
